A '''banking mogul''' from [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] had his most valuable possessions jettisoned into space with his body after his death. The coffin was later recovered by [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]], who liberated the valuables within.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|You Can't Take it with You}}</ref>
